newsitem.title: UK: Second former Liberal/SDP MP joins UK Labour Party.
newsitem.headline: Second former Liberal/SDP MP joins UK Labour Party.

text.p: Bill Pitt on Tuesday became the second former member of parliament for the British Liberal/Social Democratic alliance of the 1980s to join Tony Blair's main opposition Labour Party in a month.
Pitt, who sat as a Liberal for Croydon North West between 1981 and 1983, said the Liberal Democrats had "failed to grasp the nettle of change" while Blair was spelling out a new radical vision.
Last month, Christopher Brocklebank-Fowler who sat in parliament for both the Conservative and the Social Democrat parties, announced he was joining Labour. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7767
